app.browserPreview: This is a browser preview. Open the desktop application to connect to Twitch.
app.linkRequiresSignIn: Connect to Twitch to open the requested destination.
app.notificationTestResult: The native notification activated this local target. No Twitch channel data or playback is involved.
app.playbackStarted: Streamlink process started. Check Watching for status.
app.signInIntro: Browse the channels you follow, discover categories, and find your next stream.
app.signInPrivacy: Sign-in opens in your browser. Credentials stay in secure system storage.
auth.clientIdMissing: This build does not include a Twitch application ID. If you built it from source, follow the authentication setup in the project documentation.
auth.setupRequired: Twitch sign-in needs to be configured for this build. Open Settings for instructions.
auth.storageInfo: Credentials stay in Rust and the OS credential store.
authentication.configurationHelp: Register a new public Twitch application, set {variable} in the backend environment, and restart. See {docs}.
background.channelOverrideHelp: Channel settings can override this notification default. Startup, Resume and recovery establish a quiet baseline; already-live streams do not trigger alerts.
background.clickUnavailable: This notification provider does not support channel click actions. Restore the app from its tray or taskbar.
background.closeHelp: Monitoring and playback continue while hidden. Restore from the tray menu. If no tray is available, closing minimizes instead. Normal minimize is unchanged. Quit stops all owned playback.
background.closeToggle: Keep Stream GUI RS running in the background when the window is closed
background.deliveryFailed: A notification could not be delivered. Monitoring continues.
background.notifyToggle: Notify when followed channels go live
background.pauseHelp: Pause lasts until Resume or application restart.
background.permissionDenied: Notifications denied — change this in system settings
background.permissionOsManaged: Delivery is controlled by your desktop notification settings
background.permissionUnavailable: Native notifications unavailable. Check the app installation and OS permissions, then retry.
background.trayUnavailable: A tray is not available. Background close will minimize the window.
browse.bookmarksHint: Your saved channels and categories, on this device.
browse.categoriesHint: Find a game. Find your community.
browse.followingHint: The channels you choose to keep up with.
browse.lookupHint: Go directly to a known Twitch login.
browse.noCategoryStreams: No streams are live in this category
browse.noFollowedLive: No followed channels are live right now
browse.noFollows: You aren’t following any channels yet
browse.searchHint: Discover channels and categories on Twitch.
channel.chatBrowserOpened: Twitch chat opened in your default browser.
channel.effectiveSummary: Saved effective quality: {quality} · Low latency: {latency} · Automatic chat: {chat}
channel.notificationsStatus: Saved notifications: {state}. Requires monitoring and system permission.
channel.saved: Channel settings saved. Running streams are unchanged.
channel.scopeHelp: These preferences follow this broadcaster across name changes and apply to this app on this device. Choose the default to remove an override. Quality and low latency can inherit from the active player profile.
developer.browserPreview: Browser preview only. Backend controls require the desktop app:
developer.pathHint: Leave empty to discover on PATH
developer.probeHelp: A successful probe saves this choice. Launch checks the saved executable again.
discovery.bookmarksHelp: Local bookmarks are independent of Twitch follows. Saved names may be outdated; opening an item requests current Twitch data. Hidden bookmarks remain reachable.
discovery.hidden: Hidden from discovery. Direct navigation remains available.
discovery.hiddenHelp: Hidden channels and categories are filtered from Live and category discovery. Following, Search, Teams, bookmarks and direct navigation remain available. Restore stale items here without contacting Twitch.
discovery.noBookmarks: No bookmarks yet. Open a channel or category to bookmark it.
errors.authDenied: Twitch authorization was declined. You can try signing in again.
errors.authExpired: Your sign-in code expired. Start a new sign-in.
errors.authInvalid: Your Twitch session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
errors.authProvider: Twitch could not complete sign-in. Please try again.
errors.browserOpen: Twitch chat could not be opened in your default browser. Playback is unaffected.
errors.capacity: Browsing is busy. Please try again shortly.
errors.chatLaunch: Chatterino could not be started. Check its installation or use browser chat. Playback is unaffected.
errors.chatterinoCapacity: Too many Chatterino instances are active. Close a Chatterino window or use browser chat.
errors.chatterinoNotFound: Chatterino was not found. Install it or set its executable path in Settings. Browser chat remains available.
errors.credentialStore: Secure storage is unavailable. Unlock your system credential store and retry.
errors.incomplete: Monitoring could not complete all followed-stream pages. Retrying automatically.
errors.internal: The application could not complete this request. Try again.
errors.invalidInput: Check the search or selection and try again.
errors.invalidPlayer: Check the player path and arguments in Settings. Enter one literal argument per row.
errors.invalidResponse: Twitch returned incomplete or unexpected information. Try again.
errors.network: Twitch could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Twitch sign-in is not configured for this build. See Settings for setup instructions.
errors.notFound: This channel or category is no longer available.
errors.notification: Desktop notifications are unavailable. Check your system notification settings.
errors.playerNotFound: The selected player was not found. Check its executable path in Settings.
errors.rateLimited: Twitch’s request limit was reached. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.restartFailed: The session could not be restarted. Check its status and diagnostics, then try again.
errors.settings: The saved settings could not be read.
errors.settingsVersion: These settings were created by a different application version.
errors.startupFailed: Streamlink exited during startup. Open the session diagnostics for details.
errors.streamOffline: This channel is no longer live. Refresh the browsing view.
errors.streamlinkExited: Streamlink exited with an error. Open the session diagnostics for details.
errors.streamlinkNotFound: Streamlink was not found. Install it separately or set its path in Settings.
errors.timeout: Twitch took too long to respond. Try again.
errors.twitchServer: Twitch is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.unauthenticated: Your Twitch session has ended. Sign in to continue.
errors.unauthorized: Permission to read this information is missing. Sign out and reconnect to Twitch.
errors.unsupportedStreamlink: Playback requires Streamlink 8 or newer. Update Streamlink and test it in Settings.
lookup.help: Opens the exact channel’s details, including offline channels. Use Search to discover channels and categories.
lookup.invalidLogin: Enter a Twitch login using up to 25 letters, numbers or underscores. Do not enter a URL.
lookup.notFound: No channel has that Twitch login.
lookup.ready: Channel found. Open its details when ready.
notificationAcceptance.testQueued: Test notification queued. OS delivery is not confirmed; check your desktop notification center.
notificationTest.historyHelp: Keep the app running while testing notification history.
notificationTest.intro: Uses the native notification service. No Twitch sign-in is needed. Click the notification to open a local synthetic channel.
notificationTest.macosHelp: On macOS, verify the installed app bundle’s code signature. A rejected authorization request may leave the app absent from System Settings → Notifications.
notificationTest.permissionHelp: Allow desktop notifications before sending a test.
notificationTest.title: Native notification acceptance · development only
playback.alreadyStopped: The Streamlink process has already stopped or is stopping.
playback.chatFailure: Chat did not open. Playback is unaffected; you can open chat from channel details.
playback.empty: No playback sessions. Choose Watch on a live stream.
playback.qualityRestartHelp: Quality changes apply when you restart.
playback.runningHelp: Running means Streamlink is active; it does not confirm video playback. Streams continue when you sign out. Closing the app stops them.
playbackErrors.capacity: Playback is busy or eight streams are already active. Stop a stream or try again shortly.
playbackErrors.invalidInput: Check the executable path and playback selection, then try again.
playbackErrors.notFound: This session is no longer in the playback history.
playbackErrors.settings: Playback settings could not be saved or read. Check the settings file and try again.
playbackErrors.timeout: The playback operation took too long. Check Watching and test Streamlink in Settings.
player.argumentsHelp: One literal argument per row. Spaces, quotes, braces and empty arguments are preserved. No shell expansion.
player.automaticDiscovery: Automatic discovery of the selected player
player.streamlinkSelects: Streamlink selects its default installed player.
profiles.defaultHelp: Used when no profile is selected. Profiles replace the player; optional profile quality and low latency override these defaults.
profiles.deleted: Profile deleted. If selected, Default configuration is now active. Running streams are unchanged.
profiles.precedenceHelp: Global defaults → selected profile → channel overrides → launch quality. Running sessions keep their launch configuration; Restart uses current preferences.
profiles.saveFailed: The profile could not be saved. Use a unique name of 1–64 characters (128 bytes), and at most 16 profiles. Reopen the editor if the profile was deleted.
profiles.saveHelp: Profile changes save separately from the default settings.
profiles.saved: Profile saved. New launches and explicit restarts use the selected configuration.
search.exactTeamName: Exact team name, not a URL
search.intro: Enter a channel or category name to get started.
settings.autoExecutable: Automatic discovery from PATH and standard installation locations
settings.chatHelp: Opens the selected chat application for each launch or explicit restart. Channel details can override quality, low latency and chat independently.
settings.chatterinoHelp: Chatterino uses its own login. Each opening may start an independent window, which stays open after playback stops or this app quits. Missing Chatterino shows an error; channel details always offer browser chat.
settings.chatterinoMissing: Not found; install it or set an executable path.
settings.languageHint: System follows your operating system language. Unsupported languages use English.
settings.lowLatencyHelp: Can reduce stream delay with less buffering resilience. Actual delay depends on the stream, network and player; no specific latency is guaranteed.
settings.qualityHelp: High, Medium and Low prefer their indicated resolution and fall back to Source when needed.
settings.runningPreferencesHelp: Changing preferences leaves running streams unchanged. Explicit Quit stops playback.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Background preferences apply now; playback preferences apply to new launches and restarts.
settings.streamlinkHelp: Install Streamlink 8 or newer separately. A failed test preserves the saved path. Streamlink configuration files and sideloaded plugins are disabled.
settings.draculaDarkOnly: Dracula is available in Dark mode only. Your previous color mode returns when you choose another theme.
settings.themeHelp: System follows your desktop color preference. Save to apply your selection.
settings.themeUnavailable: Custom Theme is unavailable. Showing Default until custom-theme.json is valid again.
shortcuts.captureHelp: Press a shortcut. Escape cancels; Tab leaves capture.
shortcuts.defaultsRestored: Default shortcuts restored in the draft. Save to apply.
shortcuts.invalidBinding: Choose a modified letter, number, comma, bracket, arrow, Home or F6–F12. Q, W, N, T and L are reserved.
shortcuts.scopeHelp: Application-local shortcuts pause in text inputs and modal dialogs. Primary means Command on macOS and Ctrl on Windows/Linux. Changes apply after Save shortcuts.
streams.emptyHelp: Try refreshing, or explore another view.
streams.itemLimit: Showing up to 300 items. Refresh to start a new browsing session.
streams.previousResults: Previous results · refresh to check for updates
supportReport.contents: Includes build, platform, player mode and anonymous process status. Excludes identities, paths, arguments, credentials and raw logs.
supportReport.privacyHelp: Preview this local snapshot before sharing. Select the text and use your normal Copy action. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
teams.limitNotice: Showing the first 300 members, sorted by login. Twitch does not paginate Teams.
teams.lookupHelp: Enter the exact team name from its Twitch team address. Team lookup opens members without starting playback.
teams.memberHint.one: {count} member. Open a member to check current live status and watch.
teams.memberHint.other: {count} members. Open a member to check current live status and watch.
updates.actionFailed: The update action could not be completed. Try again later.
updates.cacheHelp: Results, including failures, are kept for 24 hours while this app runs. Explicit refresh is limited to once per minute. No background checks or notifications.
updates.current: Stream GUI RS is up to date
updates.development: This build is newer than stable version {version}.
updates.sourceHelp: Checks the official GitHub repository for stable releases. Checks are manual; nothing is installed or downloaded automatically.
